versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.1 of vlmrun-cli-skill

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Documentation and usage instructions remain unchanged.

Initial release of vlmrun-cli-skill

- Introduces a CLI for interacting with the VLM Run Orion visual AI agent.
- Supports natural language image, video, and document processing: understanding, generation, object detection, OCR, summarization, extraction, and chat.
- Provides clear CLI setup instructions and required environment variables.
- Details multiple usage options, flags, and session management.
- Includes extensive example commands for various visual and document AI tasks.
